scenes.text: Claude built it in four phases, one prompt each. The request form even previews the approval chain before you submit.
But the useful part is what broke. Escalation could hand a step to someone who owned a later step, so they'd approve the same request twice. And Slack showed approval times in UTC.
Kissflow doesn't publish prices. If your team just needs spend approvals, you mostly need the form, the rules, and a record of who approved what.
